key_reasoning.reason: Diffstat reports 7 files changed (L under the actual-mode mapping 7-10), but 3 are tests and 1 is a guide; only 3 source files change, with 143 insertions and 64 deletions in total.

Three components across two layers: the session_money cost_available rule (zero-token rows count as no usage, so a session with no usage is a known $0.00), the cli_analytics_handler that consumes it for the sessions list and detail, and the Postgres reader that supplies the per-model token rows.

Small change to an existing CatalogPricer-based pricing pattern. It reuses kind_tokens, the same zero-token test the pricer already applies. Tests are covered by the existing unit and live-Postgres regression templates. No security, performance or schema impact, and rollback is trivial.
